g.text: (a) If the quantification limit were a property of the instrument, every pair would sit in the first bar
56.4% do not, and the limit moves by more than a factor of ten in 19.7% of them

text.tspan: (b) The amendment moves the list into those decades: 8 of 24 additions sit below µg/L (33%), against 7 of 35 on the legacy list (20%)
